page.layout: One printed page, one text block in two columns, with centred small headings between the rows. No notes in the margins: the left strip is the neighbouring page's edge. Running head at top, page number at top right, catchword at the foot right.

main_text.l: calumnia, | nens recta à prauis, af-
main_text.head: Cum modestia:
main_text.l: Superbia, φιλαυτία, arrogantia, contemptus aliorum: | Abiectio hypocritica, seu extenuatio immodica suorum donorum: item assentatio, omnia aliorũ nostris præferēs.
main_text.head: Cum mansuetudine:
main_text.l: Iracundia, acerbitas, morositas, cupiditas uindictæ: | ἀοργησία, patientia parasitica, simulatio lenitatis occultè captans occasionem ulciscendi.
main_text.head: Cum beneficentia:
main_text.l: Sordes, illiberalitas, tenacitas, maleuolētia, cupiditas lædēdi, premendi, impediendi alios: | Prodigalitas, largitiones officiorum, profusio, facilitas erga quoslibet, neglectis suis reb.
main_text.head: Cum gratitudine:
main_text.l: Ingratitudo, nocere benefactori: | Seruitus, cùm quis gratificatur benefacere in re turpi aut impia.
main_text.head: Cum iustitia:
main_text.l: Rapacitas, πλεονεξία, fraudatio: | Rigor iuris, ἀκριβοδι-καιον.

page.notes: The Greek word after "Rigor iuris," is printed across a line break as "ἀκριβοδί-" and "καιον." and is doubtful; the first Greek word of the modestia row and the one in the mansuetudine row are read with some doubt. The page number reads "61", printed in italic at top right. The left strip shows the facing page's edge text and is left out.
